messages:
maria: Heads-up — planning to pin aegis-lite-v2 to slot-42 in staging today during the 11:00-12:00 PST quiet window. Need smoke + rollback ready.
lee: Ack, can do 11:00. Who's owning smoke tests?
sanjay: I'll run smoke and perf checks, will share script. ping me 10 mins before deploy.
alex: I can handle the actual pin and alias swap. I'll run the rollback command if anything flakey.
joanne: Are there infra changes? any quant/ops flags?
maria: No infra change. Model is quantized 4-bit, kernel profile Q4F, verified on staging nodes. Migration steps: 1) upload artifact 2) pin to slot-42 3) alias swap 4) smoke
maria: Smoke script (sanjay):
```
# smoke.sh
curl -s -X POST https://staging.redwood/api/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"model":"aegis-lite-v2","prompt":"hello world","max_new_tokens":20}' | jq .
```
lee: Sweet. Expected latency under 120ms 95th; watch token-cost spike.
alex: Pin command I'll run:
```
redwood catalog pin --model aegis-lite-v2 --slot slot-42 --region us-west-2
```
alex: Rollback is:
```
redwood catalog swap-alias --alias aegis-lite --version aegis-lite-v1
```
deploy-bot: Deploy queued by alex; estimated duration 4m. CI checks passed.
maria: Please capture logs to /aws/s3/redwood/staging/smoke-aegis-lite-v2/
sanjay: I'll collect perf traces and quick evals. Do we need canary at 10% first?
joanne: Since it's same architecture and small traffic, canary not required, but let's keep 10min observation after swap.
lee: I'll watch routing and batching metrics (dash: /console/models/aegis-lite/metrics).
alex: ETA 11:05 start; tagging with @sanjay for smoke, @lee for metrics, @joanne for readiness.
maria: If no major regressions by 11:15, we'll promote to production slot-1 tomorrow morning at 09:00 PT. If rollback needed, execute alex's command and notify #eng-oncall.
joanne: Noted. I'll be on-call 11:00–11:30.
sanjay: smoke green locally, sample outputs look ok, minimal hallucinations.
lee: metrics look stable, p95 ~98ms, token cost normal. No CPU/GPU spikes.
alex: swap complete. alias aegis-lite -> aegis-lite-v2
maria: :tada: thanks team. archiving smoke logs and creating a follow-up ticket for quality-monitoring to add prompt-set.
alex: filing PR to pin in catalog repo: refs/changes/1234
sanjay: one follow-up: add an eval that includes the new tokenizer edge-case we saw.
maria: good catch. closing thread, ping me if any late regressions.
deploy-bot: Auto-close: thread marked resolved by maria.
